criteria.id: uploading a PDF stores a source document and extracts text into parse status, errors, and chunks
uploading a Word document stores a source document and extracts text into chunks
an image with understanding or OCR extracts text; an image without understanding stays pending with a parse error
analysis extracts business goals, actors, scenarios, constraints, risks, assumptions, open questions, and acceptance criteria
LLM analysis can generate Bug candidates in addition to Epic, Feature, Story, Task, and Research nodes
generated candidates keep source references to messages, documents, or chunks where possible
human approval is still required before candidates become WorkItems
LLM analysis fails loud when no extractor is configured
customers can upload attachments and run analysis on their own intake sessions
